question: In the first movie that Emma Stone won an Academy Award for Best Actress in, did her costar win an Academy Award for Best Actor?
reference: Ryan Gosling was nominated for an Academy Award for Best Actor in La La Land, but didn't win.
output_text:
• Emma Stone won her first Academy Award for Best Actress at the 2024 Academy Awards (96th Academy Awards) for her role in "Poor Things" [1, 2]

• In "Poor Things," Emma Stone's male costar was Mark Ruffalo, who won the Academy Award for Best Actor in a Supporting Role at the same ceremony [1]

• Mark Ruffalo won an Academy Award, but it was in the Supporting Actor category, not the Best Actor category [1]

• Cillian Murphy won the Best Actor award at the 2024 Academy Awards, but he won it for "Oppenheimer," not for "Poor Things" [2]

Final answer: No. Emma Stone's costar in "Poor Things" (her first Best Actress Oscar win) was Mark Ruffalo, who won an Academy Award for Best Supporting Actor for that film, not Best Actor. The Best Actor award that year went to Cillian Murphy for a different film ("Oppenheimer").
final_answer: No. Emma Stone's costar in "Poor Things" (her first Best Actress Oscar win) was Mark Ruffalo, who won an Academy Award for Best Supporting Actor for that film, not Best Actor. The Best Actor award that year went to Cillian Murphy for a different film ("Oppenheimer").
